messages:
aline: Heads-up — we're planning a routing policy update for EU -> APAC gradual handoff tonight. Target window 22:00-22:30 UTC. Will nudge EU->APAC weights 80->20 over 15m. Need SMOKE coverage + rollback thumbs.
sam: I'm the deploy owner. I'll run the weight changes and watch metrics. ETA 22:00 UTC. I'll also push a config tag so we can revert quickly.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: 1824509123 | Author: sam | Action: regional-route-weight-update | Window: 2026-03-17T22:00Z-22:30Z | Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/route-weight
jen: Quick q — TTL is currently 60s for edge DNS? Are we changing TTL? We should set low TTL before the nudge.
raj: TTL is 30s on the health checks layer, 60s for public. I can lower public to 15s at 21:45 UTC if you want.
marta: I'll own smoke checks for EU and APAC — will validate 200s, header X-Region, and latency tail. Plan: curl + small script.
marta: smoke commands I'll run:
```
curl -s -H 'Host: app.redwood.example' https://eu-edge-1.example/health | jq .region
for i in {1..30}; do curl -s https://apac-edge-1.example/ping >/dev/null && echo up; sleep 2; done
```
ops-oncall: I'm on standby. Rollback plan: restore weights to 100% EU and re-instate prev routing policy. Quick revert command:
```
redwoodctl route set-weight --region eu --weight 100 --policy id=route123
```
sam: I'll create a canary at 10% for 5m before the main nudge. If no errors, proceed to 20/80 steps. If >1% 5xx or p90 latency > 500ms, abort and rollback.
aline: Add to checklist: 1) Lower DNS TTL 21:45 2) Prewarm APAC cache 21:55 3) Canary 22:00 10% 5m 4) Nudge to 20% 15m 5) Post-checks & metrics 22:30
jen: Support FYI — I'll post a short banner in #support and update status page if needed.
marta: will post smoke results in this thread as I run them. +1 on prewarm — I'll trigger cache prewarm script.
sam: tagging @raj @marta @ops-oncall — please ack if you'll be available in the window.
raj: ack, available. I'll also monitor edge errors and adjust healthcheck thresholds if needed.
ops-oncall: ack. Slack pager on. macro set for rollback. :white_check_mark:
aline: thanks. If anyone spots unexpected 429/5xx spike, send 'abort' in this thread and I'll freeze changes.
marta: smoke: eu health x-region looks good. apac ping latency ~120ms for first 20 checks. posting artifacts:
https://artifacts.internal/smokes/1824509123
sam: can someone double-check permissions for redwoodctl? Last time we had a transient perms issue.
jen: perms OK for you, sam. I just validated RBAC session for deploy role.
deploy-bot: Reminder — attach post-deploy checklist and tag infra@redwood for billing metrics rollup.
aline: final call at 21:58 UTC. If no objections, proceed with the plan.
raj: no objections.
marta: no objections.
ops-oncall: good to go.
sam: starting TTL change at 21:45 UTC. I'll post updates as steps complete. :rocket:
